meta_title: Omar's Man & Van | Removal Service Manchester
meta_description: Omar's Man and Van Services offers reliable, affordable removals across Manchester. Friendly local team, careful handling, and flexible slots. Call for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Moving home or office? We arrive on time, handle your belongings with care, and get you settled without the stress.
services_heading: Complete Removal Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From single-item collections to full household moves, we tailor every job to suit your needs and budget.

services.title: House Removals
services.desc: We handle every stage of your home move, from careful packing through to unloading at your new property. Our team treats your furniture and belongings as if they were our own.

services.title: Flat & Apartment Moves
services.desc: Navigating stairs, lifts, and tight corridors is no problem for our experienced crew. We work quickly and cleanly so you can get settled into your new flat without delay.

services.title: Office & Business Relocations
services.desc: Minimise downtime with a smooth, organised office move planned around your schedule. We handle desks, IT equipment, and filing with discretion and care.

services.title: Single Item & Furniture Delivery
services.desc: Need a sofa, wardrobe, or large appliance collected and delivered? We offer flexible single-item runs across Manchester at competitive rates.

services.title: Student Moves
services.desc: Affordable and straightforward moves for students relocating within Manchester or across the city. We work around term dates and tight budgets — just let us know what you need.

services.title: Packing & Unpacking Assistance
services.desc: Short on time before moving day? Our team can pack your belongings securely using quality materials, and unpack everything neatly at your new address.

about_pullquote: Every move matters to us — we treat your home like our own.
about_para_1: Omar's Man and Van Services was founded right here in Manchester with a simple aim: to offer honest, reliable removals at a price that makes sense. Based at Storage World on Ashton Old Road, we are ideally positioned to serve customers across the city and surrounding areas. Our fully insured team has built a strong reputation through word of mouth and repeat business.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is the personal touch — you speak directly with us, get a straight quote, and we turn up when we say we will. We take pride in looking after your belongings and leaving every customer happy from start to finish. That commitment to quality is why so many Manchester residents and businesses come back to us time and again.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Omar and his team were absolutely brilliant. Turned up on time, worked incredibly fast, and nothing was damaged. Couldn't have asked for a better move. Will definitely use again and recommend to everyone.
reviews.author: Liam T.

reviews.text: Used Omar's for my flat move in Ardwick. Brilliant service from start to finish — very professional, friendly lads and great value. Made what I thought was going to be a stressful day really easy.
reviews.author: Priya S.

reviews.text: Needed a last-minute van for a sofa collection and Omar sorted it the same day. Reasonable price, no fuss, and great communication throughout. Highly recommend for anyone needing a reliable man and van in Manchester.
reviews.author: Daniel R.
